scenicChapters.title: Var - Dealul Tărăvăilor → Agrij - Coasta Lată
scenicChapters.narrative: Slow enough to look. The surface follows the shoreline, so the corners arrive where the water decided, not where an engineer did. Water arrives beside the road and stays for 34 km. The line follows the shore because there is nowhere else for it to go.

places-dobricel-varful-lazului-agrij-coa.story: A 276 km round trip from Spermezeu - roughly 4 h 46 in the saddle. The stops in between: Cășeiu - Cetățele / Samvm Cășeiu -Samum, Rogna - La Bontauă, Var - Dealul Tărăvăilor and Agrij - Coasta Lată. It keeps close to the shore for long stretches.
